006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.time.Duration;
009import java.time.ZoneOffset;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DateTimeFunctionException;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.DayTimeDurationItemImpl;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
017import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
019
020/**
021 * An atomic Metapath item containing a duration data value in days, hours, and
022 * seconds.
023 */
024public interface IDayTimeDurationItem extends IDurationItem {
025  /**
026   * Get the type information for this item.
027   *
028   * @return the type information
029   */
030  @NonNull
031  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDayTimeDurationItem> type() {
032    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DAY_TIME_DURATION.getItemType();
033  }
034
035  @Override
036  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IDayTimeDurationItem> getType() {
037    return type();
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Construct a new day time duration item using the provided string
042   * {@code value}.
043   *
044   * @param value
045   *          a string representing a day time duration
046   * @return the new item
047   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
048   *           if the provided string value is not a day/time duration value
049   *           according to ISO 8601
050   */
051  @NonNull
052  static IDayTimeDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
053    try {
054      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DAY_TIME_DURATION.parse(value));
055    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
056      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
057          null,
058          String.format("Invalid day/time value '%s',",
059              value),
060          ex);
061    }
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Construct a new day time duration item using the provided {@code value}.
066   *
067   * @param value
068   *          a duration
069   * @return the new item
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  static IDayTimeDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull Duration value) {
073    return new DayTimeDurationItemImpl(value);
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Get the items wrapped value as a duration.
078   *
079   * @return the wrapped value as a duration
080   */
081  @NonNull
082  Duration asDuration();
083
084  /**
085   * Get the "wrapped" duration value in seconds.
086   *
087   * @return the underlying duration in seconds
088   */
089  default long asSeconds() {
090    return asDuration().toSeconds();
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Returns a copy of this duration with the amount negated.
095   *
096   * @return this duration with the amount negated
097   */
098  @NonNull
099  default IDayTimeDurationItem negate() {
100    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asDuration().negated()));
101  }
102
103  /**
104   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
105   *
106   * @param item
107   *          the item to cast
108   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
109   *         cast to this type
110   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
111   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
112   */
113  @NonNull
114  static IDayTimeDurationItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
115    try {
116      return item instanceof IDayTimeDurationItem
117          ? (IDayTimeDurationItem) item
118          : valueOf(item.asString());
119    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
120      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
121      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
122    }
123  }
124
125  @Override
126  default IDayTimeDurationItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
127    return cast(item);
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Compares this value with the argument.
132   *
133   * @param item
134   *          the item to compare with this value
135   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
136   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
137   */
138  default int compareTo(@NonNull IDayTimeDurationItem item) {
139    return asDuration().compareTo(item.asDuration());
140
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Get a zone offset for this duration.
145   *
146   * @return the offset
147   * @throws DateTimeFunctionException
148   *           with code
149   *           {@link DateTimeFunctionException#INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR} if
150   *           the offset is &lt; -PT14H or &gt; PT14H
151   */
152  @NonNull
153  ZoneOffset asZoneOffset();
154}
